title: agentic.config.json
description: Gates-as-data plus project mechanics for the agentic harness. Policy (approval points, loop caps) lives in approvals.yaml, not here. Note: the harness validates this file with hand-rolled checks in .agentic/harness/src/config.ts; this schema is documentation and editor tooling.

preset.description: Name of the applied preset (.agentic/presets/<name>.json), or "self"/"custom".

srcDirs.description: Implementation source directories (repo-relative). Used by the integrity gate to spot mixed implementation+test diffs.

testGlobs.description: Globs (supports **, *, ?) matching test files. The integrity gate fails on deletions under these globs.

gates.description: Ordered map: gate name -> gate definition. Declaration order is execution order. Canonical names presets bind: format, lint, typecheck, test, coverage, integrity, memory, security, build, e2e (extra names allowed).

command.description: Shell command run via `sh -c` from the repo root. Required unless optional is true.

tier.description: fast: every commit / pre-push / PR CI. full: pre-merge / merge queue.

optional.description: Optional gates missing a command are skipped with a notice instead of failing.

timeoutSeconds.description: Kill the gate's process group after this many seconds; a timeout is a failure.

loop.description: Default runner ONLY — the loop's hard caps live in approvals.yaml.

runner.description: Default agent runner: claude, copilot, or mock.

coreBudgetLines.description: memory lint fails when MEMORY.md exceeds this many lines.

staleDays.description: memory lint warns when activeContext.md lags HEAD by more than this many days.

designs.description: Design doc pipeline: self-contained single-file HTML design documents validated by `agentic design check` and previewed via `agentic serve`.

dir.description: Directory holding *.html design docs (repo-relative). TEMPLATE.html inside it is the `design new` scaffold and is excluded from checks.

publishCommand.description: Shell command run via `sh -c` from the repo root by `agentic design publish`, with DESIGN_FILE (absolute path) and DESIGN_SLUG in the environment. Publishing is disabled when unset.
